latest.notes:
The assistant can now see and set the music attributes.

Ask it for a song's vocal gender, BPM or tempo and it can answer — library searches now show them. Ask it to set one and it prepares a card the way it does for any other change: 'set the vocal gender on everything by Carly Simon to female', 'clear the tempo override on these three so the BPM decides again'. A field you don't mention is left alone, so a request about gender can never wipe a BPM, and anything in the selection that isn't music is skipped and reported rather than failing the whole thing.

Clocks too: it can put a tempo on a music slot when creating or editing a clock, and it reads existing slot tempos back.

It also now knows the rule that matters — tempo follows the measured BPM through your bands, so a wrong BPM is the thing to correct; the override is only for a song whose number is right and whose feel is wrong.

Also fixed: a gap in the assistant's permission gate meant a newly added proposal tool could be offered to read-only operators.
